selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What main feature of the universe is presented at the start of the Fifth Truth?
questions.answer: It presents the universe as marked by extremely complete order and regularity in all its parts.

questions.question: Besides order, what similarity is described among the substances and living beings involved in running the world?
questions.answer: They are described as sharing the same basic nature and fitting into one overall system and purpose.

questions.question: How are the Divine Names and actions described in relation to the world?
questions.answer: They are shown as reaching across all or most things and working everywhere within the world.

questions.question: What is said about the elements and species spread across the earth?
questions.answer: They are spread over the whole earth even though the same kinds appear again and again in many places.

questions.question: Why does the passage treat widespread order and sameness as evidence?
questions.answer: Because such unity and harmony point to one source directing everything rather than many separate controllers.

questions.question: According to the passage, who is the Maker and Manager of the universe?
questions.answer: He is one, unique, and alone.

questions.question: What relationships or limitations are denied about Allah in this passage?
questions.answer: It denies that He has any equal, helper, partner, rival, weakness, or deficiency.

questions.question: How does the passage connect order with belief in Divine oneness?
questions.answer: It says true order itself shows one organizer behind it.

questions.question: Why does the passage say there is no room for associating partners with Allah?
questions.answer: Because assigning partners would lead to conflict and disorder, which goes against the clear harmony seen in creation.

questions.question: What overall conclusion should a reader draw from the Fifth Truth?
questions.answer: The whole universe, through its organized and unified structure, clearly testifies that its Lord is one.

questions.question: In the Fifth Truth, how is the cosmos described as a whole?
questions.answer: It is described as a complete and well-managed system whose parts work in harmony.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest by saying many things are nested within one another and still operate in harmony?
questions.answer: It suggests that one power governs layered and connected parts without confusion.

questions.question: How does the repetition of the same kinds of elements and species across the earth support the main claim?
questions.answer: It shows a single plan and a single will at work across distant places.

questions.question: What titles are given to Allah in this passage to show His authority over creation?
questions.answer: He is described as the Maker, Disposer, Monarch, Nurturer, Master, and Builder.

questions.question: What does the word “sole” add to the description of Allah here?
questions.answer: It stresses that He alone rules and no one shares His authority.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah having assistants or ministers?
questions.answer: It teaches that He has none because His rule and power are complete on their own.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah having any opposite or rival?
questions.answer: It says He has no opposite or rival at all.

questions.question: How does the passage address the idea of weakness or lack in Allah?
questions.answer: It completely rejects both, teaching that no inability or imperfection belongs to Him.

questions.question: What is the link between many gods and conflict in the passage’s reasoning?
questions.answer: The passage connects multiple claimants to authority with disagreement and division, which would break the visible order of the world.

questions.question: State the central belief affirmed by the Fifth Truth in one sentence.
questions.answer: The perfect harmony of the universe proves that its Creator and Sustainer is one without partner.

questions.question: What does the Fifth Truth say about regularity in the universe?
questions.answer: It says regularity appears throughout the whole universe in a highly perfect way.

questions.question: How are the beings that help carry out the world’s functioning described?
questions.answer: They are described as sharing the same kind of substance and serving meaningful purposes within a larger order.

questions.question: What does it mean that the Divine Names and deeds “encompass” things in the world?
questions.answer: It means their effects are not limited to one area but are seen broadly throughout creation.

questions.question: Why is it important in the passage that the same Names and actions appear in every place?
questions.answer: Because that sameness suggests one Lord acting consistently everywhere.
